WindowGuides_PluginDesc: Shows screen-center guides and snaps the quick search window while Shift is held during a drag.
WindowGuides_Config_GuideOpacityDesc: Opacity of the horizontal and vertical center guides.
WindowGuides_Config_GuideThicknessDesc: Line thickness of the horizontal and vertical center guides.
WindowGuides_Config_OutlineOpacityDesc: Opacity of the search-card outline shown while dragging.
WindowGuides_Config_OutlineThicknessDesc: Line thickness of the search-card outline shown while dragging.
